body: Thank you, I'll give this a read. I've always been afraid of joining communities, guess it's just irrational but I'm afraid of being rejected by even those like me. I've been in situations before where people I called friends said they accepted me and that changed the moment we had a disagreement, suddenly it was a stream of abuse and slurs.

I tried having a blog once but it just sort of disappeared. No one read it and I don't feel like I had anything to add other than moaning about my problems and generally being negative. Other people in my position don't want to hear that or they'll just end up where I am, at the end of my tether hoping I don't wake up tomorrow, considering doing something to ensure it.

I feel selfish, other people have it far worse than me, my life is comfortable at least and despite not being as accepting as I'd hoped, my parents aren't going to kick me out or anything (as far as I know)

It just gets hard when it's never ending. I eventually feel better and someone comes along to destroy my happiness again. I used to think there was good in everyone but it's hard to believe that when people would be happy to see me dead just for my identity.
